asus - v16 16\" 2k gaming laptop - intel.name: ASUS - V16 16" 2K Gaming Laptop - Intel Core 7 Processor 240H with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 - 8GB Memory - 512GB SSD - Black
asus - v16 16\" 2k gaming laptop - intel.description: Meet the ASUS V16, your all-access pass to gaming and creating on the move. A 16-inch 144Hz display with a 16:10 aspect ratio and 100% sRGB color keeps fast action smooth and detail sharp, while the anti-glare finish cuts reflections wherever you set up. Inside, an Intel Core 7 Processor 240H and the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU with 8GB GDDR7 bring ray tracing and DLSS 4 to your games and AI acceleration to your creative projects. ASUS IceCool thermal technology with dual fans and heat pipes holds performance steady through long sessions. 8GB of DDR5 memory handles heavy multitasking, dual memory slots leave room to expand, and a 512GB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD loads large files almost instantly. Wi-Fi 6, HDMI 2.1, USB Type-C with display output and charging, and a 63Wh battery in a 4.30 lb chassis mean you're ready to go anywhere.
